paragraphs.text: Seaweed has been eaten in parts of East Asia for thousands of years, but it is only recently that it has become popular in Europe and North America. Supermarkets now sell seaweed snacks, and some chefs use it in place of salt.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Nutritionists point out that many types of seaweed are rich in iodine, which the body needs to produce certain hormones. However, eating large amounts of some varieties can provide far more iodine than is healthy.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Seaweed farming has environmental benefits. It needs no fresh water or fertiliser, and the growing plants absorb carbon dioxide from the sea. Some farms are placed near fish farms, where the seaweed takes up waste nutrients from the fish.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: The industry faces challenges. Storms can destroy farms, and seaweed must be dried or processed quickly after harvest, which requires energy. In some regions, local fishermen have objected to farms that occupy traditional fishing areas.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: Seaweed has been eaten in parts of East Asia for thousands of years
items.prompt: In parts of East Asia, seaweed

explanation.en: In East Asia seaweed “has been eaten … for thousands of years” — long part of the diet. F about salt refers to chefs in the West → B.
explanation.kk: Шығыс Азияда теңіз балдырын «has been eaten … for thousands of years» — ол ежелден тағамның бөлігі. Тұз туралы F Батыстағы аспаздарға қатысты → B.
explanation.ru: В Восточной Азии морские водоросли «has been eaten … for thousands of years» — они давно входят в рацион. F про соль относится к поварам на Западе → B.

items.quote: some chefs use it in place of salt

explanation.en: “some chefs use it in place of salt” → F. “Instead of” = “in place of”. G about price is not supported.
explanation.kk: «some chefs use it in place of salt» → F. «Instead of» = «in place of». G баға туралы — мәтінде расталмайды.
explanation.ru: «some chefs use it in place of salt» → F. «Instead of» = «in place of». G о цене в тексте не подтверждается.

items.quote: eating large amounts of some varieties can provide far more iodine than is healthy
items.prompt: Eating large quantities of certain seaweeds
keywords: far more iodine than is healthy

explanation.en: Iodine is useful, but large amounts of some types give “far more iodine than is healthy” → C.
explanation.kk: Йод пайдалы, бірақ кейбір түрлерін көп жесе, «far more iodine than is healthy» → C.
explanation.ru: Йод полезен, но большие количества некоторых видов дают «far more iodine than is healthy» → C.

items.quote: the seaweed takes up waste nutrients from the fish
items.prompt: Seaweed grown close to fish farms

explanation.en: “the seaweed takes up waste nutrients from the fish” → A. D contradicts the text: no fresh water is needed.
explanation.kk: «the seaweed takes up waste nutrients from the fish» → A. D мәтінге қайшы: тұщы су мүлде керек емес.
explanation.ru: «the seaweed takes up waste nutrients from the fish» → A. D противоречит тексту: пресная вода не нужна вовсе.

items.quote: seaweed must be dried or processed quickly after harvest
items.prompt: Seaweed that has just been harvested

explanation.en: After harvest seaweed “must be dried or processed quickly”, which uses energy. “Soon after it is collected” = “quickly after harvest” → E.
explanation.kk: Жиналған балдыр «must be dried or processed quickly after harvest», әрі бұған энергия керек. «Soon after it is collected» = «quickly after harvest» → E.
explanation.ru: После сбора водоросли «must be dried or processed quickly after harvest», и это требует энергии. «Soon after it is collected» = «quickly after harvest» → E.

can supply too much of a useful substance.
needs large amounts of fresh water.
